mapper.select: WITH new_master AS (INSERT INTO food_master(food_name,category,default_quantity_unit) VALUES(#{foodName},#{category,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{quantityUnit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) RETURNING master_id) INSERT INTO food_item (master_id, storage_type, quantity_text, expired_at, purchased_at, opened_at, frozen_at, source_type, freeze_type, status, memo, created_at, updated_at, capacity_text, source_memo, sell_by_at, quantity_amount, quantity_unit) VALUES ((SELECT master_id FROM new_master), #{storageType}, #{quantityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiredAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{purchasedAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{openedAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{frozenAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{freezeType}, #{status}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{capacityText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceMemo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sellByAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{quantityAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{quantityUnit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) RETURNING food_id

SELECT food_id, m.food_name, storage_type, m.category, quantity_text, expired_at, purchased_at, opened_at, frozen_at, source_type, freeze_type, status, memo, i.created_at, i.updated_at, capacity_text, source_memo, sell_by_at, quantity_amount, quantity_unit FROM food_item i JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=i.master_id WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, food_id DESC
